title: Skills split, symlink-safe scan, and the rules that moved
summary: This change splits the repository's agent rules into three layers: the root AGENTS.md keeps only what every task needs, a new crates/AGENTS.md and .github/workflows/AGENTS.md carry folder-scoped rules, and six new skills under .agents/skills/ carry rules that load at the moment a task matches. .claude/skills becomes a symlink to .agents/skills so Claude Code reads the same files, and ci.yml gains two jobs that lint every skill and assert the symlink is still a symlink. The one code change is in osf scan: a tracked symlink is now skipped rather than read as the file or directory it points at, with a new test helper and test covering it.

lanes.subtitle: where rules are read
lanes.summary: The coding agents working in this repository, and the rule files they load: the root AGENTS.md, the folder-scoped AGENTS.md files, and the skills.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: Rust workspace
lanes.summary: The osf binary and the library crates behind it. The scan command is the only part of this change that is code.

lanes.label: GitHub Actions
lanes.subtitle: ci.yml
lanes.summary: The workflow that gates a pull request. Two new steps were added to the existing hygiene job.

lanes.label: Repository tree
lanes.subtitle: tracked files
lanes.summary: What git tracks: regular files, and the .claude/skills symlink that must stay a symlink.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md
nodes.subtitle: root rules, every task
nodes.summary: Rewritten to hold only what every task needs. The working-posture, code-layout, bootstrap and branch sections moved out to crates/AGENTS.md, .github/workflows/AGENTS.md and the new skills. A new 'Where the other rules live' table points at each of them.

nodes.label: crates/AGENTS.md
nodes.subtitle: rules for crates/
nodes.summary: New folder-scoped rules: the thin-binary and one-crate-per-group layout, Rust for the engine, and the four commands to run before pushing under crates/.

nodes.label: .github/workflows/AGENTS.md
nodes.subtitle: rules for workflows
nodes.summary: New folder-scoped rules for workflow files: judge jobs defined on the base branch, no secret beside a checked-out pull request tree, actions pinned to a commit SHA, least-privilege permissions, harden-runner in block mode, and review aids that never fail a check.

nodes.label: .agents/skills/
nodes.subtitle: 6 new skills
nodes.summary: Six new skills, each a SKILL.md with a numbered rule list and a stop condition: adding-an-osf-command, filing-an-issue, opening-a-pull-request, reviewing-a-pull-request, running-sub-agents, writing-a-workflow. Each rule says whether it is checked, not checked yet, or needs judgment.

nodes.label: .claude/skills
nodes.subtitle: symlink → ../.agents/skills
nodes.summary: A symlink so Claude Code, which reads only .claude/skills, sees the same skill files as every other agent. It must stay a symlink; a copy would drift.

nodes.label: osf scan
nodes.subtitle: scan_paths
nodes.summary: The scan walker. It now checks symlink_metadata before reading a tracked path and skips anything that is a symlink, so a link is never read as the file or directory it points at.

nodes.label: scan tests
nodes.subtitle: tests/scan.rs, tests/common
nodes.summary: A new test asserts a tracked symlink to a directory is skipped rather than read, and TempRepo gains a symlink helper that creates the link the way a real symlink resolves it, with a Windows branch for dir versus file.

nodes.label: hygiene job
nodes.subtitle: ci.yml
nodes.summary: The existing job that builds osf and runs the writing gate. Two steps were added ahead of the gate: one lints every skill, one asserts the .claude/skills symlink.

nodes.label: Check the skills
nodes.subtitle: osf lint skill
nodes.summary: Lists every tracked skills/*/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md, and runs osf lint skill over all of them on every run. Skills are few and cheap, so this is not scoped to the change.

nodes.label: Check the Claude Code skills link
nodes.subtitle: git ls-files -s
nodes.summary: Reads the git mode of .claude/skills and fails unless it is 120000, then reads the link target and fails unless it is ../.agents/skills. The error text carries the fix, including the Windows core.symlinks and developer-mode steps.

nodes.label: tracked files
nodes.subtitle: git index
nodes.summary: The set of paths git tracks, which is what osf scan walks and what the symlink check reads its mode from.

flows.title: Every skill is linted on each run
flows.summary: The hygiene job enumerates the tracked skill directories and hands them to osf lint skill, which reads each SKILL.md and reports.

messages.label: git ls-files skills/*/SKILL.md .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md
messages.note: Both the shipped skills and the repository's own skills are listed, so a new skill is checked the moment it is committed.

flows.title: The .claude/skills link is asserted, not assumed
flows.summary: The hygiene job reads the git mode and the link target of .claude/skills and fails with a fix in the message when either is wrong.

messages.label: git ls-files -s .claude/skills
messages.note: A mode other than 120000 means the link was committed as a regular file or directory, which is the drift this check exists to catch.

messages.label: ::error:: with the fix
messages.note: The failure message names the Windows core.symlinks and developer-mode steps, so the fix is in the log rather than in a wiki.
